<div class="card-body">
'''Death Star Tractor Beam''' is a [[Dark]] [[Device]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">デス・スター牽引ビーム</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">2フォース消費して「ドッキング・ベイ327」に配備する。デス・スター星系上での戦闘の終了時に、そこにいる宇宙船を1つ選んで目標とする。ただし、モン・カラマリ・スター・クルーザーは目標にできない。2フォース消費して運命数を2つ引く。運命数の合計＞装甲値または回避値なら、目標を捕まえる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Death-Star-Tractor-Beam-SWCA-67737.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">「どうしてあの衛星の方に進んでるんだ？」</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Death Star tractor beam.

'''Card text:'''
Use 2 Force to deploy on Docking Bay 327. At the end of a battle at the Death Star system, choose one starship there as the target. A Mon Calamari Star Cruiser may not be targeted. Use 2 Force to draw two destiny. If total destiny > armor or maneuver, capture the target.

'''Lore:'''
“Why are we heading toward that moon?”

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese lore asks why they are heading toward that moon; the English asks why they are still moving towards it.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Death Star Tractor Beam]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
